Resolves #21359

This brings Joshua’s existing fork commit upstream under the documented maintainer handoff. The commit removes the button’s test margins and console handler, gives the badge a starting value of 0, and updates the nested example’s headings to 1, 2, 2.1, 3. The intro now names the Inspector.

The first click still needs a repair before merge. This component exposes `badgeText` as a reactive property. The current `getBadgeText()` and `setBadgeText()` calls are unavailable. Use `handler: data => data.component.badgeText = String(Number(data.component.badgeText) + 1)` and verify 0 → 1 → 2. [Maintainer handoff and suggested fix](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21359#issuecomment-7068957569)

Evidence: L1 for the three-file scope and L3 for the nested-components test. The button click and before-and-after views still require L3 evidence.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | Source confirms the margins and console handler were removed. The current head stays at 0 on click. The suggested property assignment advanced 0 → 1 → 2 at both sizes and in the dark and Neo Light presets in a temporary copy. |
| AC-2 | The diff numbers the headings in reading order, using 2.1 for the child of the classic container, and names the Inspector. |
| AC-3 | `NestedComponentsNL.spec.mjs` passed on the GitHub integration commit `4efc950996f4` (`dev` `9f0c242251cb` plus Joshua’s head `7ef1c5b6e784`). |
| AC-4 | Captured 16 local comparison frames at 1440×900 and 390×844 across the two examples, both snapshots, and both presets. Attach the comparison with the final repair head before merge. |
| AC-5 | The upstream comparison contains exactly three files across the two example folders. Catalog records and cover images are tracked by #21932. |

## Deltas from ticket

The upstream PR opens Joshua’s original fork commit. The click repair and the specified browser evidence are pre-merge work.

## Test Evidence

Static review covered all three upstream diff files at contributor commit `7ef1c5b6e784ba24a91f80432daf0a89b51898dd`. `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/rendering/NestedComponentsNL.spec.mjs --workers=1 --reporter=line` passed (1 test, 10.3 s) with a dedicated test bridge. The live browser confirmed the contributor head’s badge stays at 0, and the isolated one-line repair increments it twice in all four size and theme combinations. The repair has yet to land on the fork. The nested headings and Inspector wording passed in the same four combinations.

Hosted CI reports a [Gantt Neo Light alignment failure](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45061649291/job/137328726308) and a [six-minute timeout after 74 passing tests](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45061649291/job/137328726307). The 291 px Gantt mismatch also reproduced in 1 of 5 focused runs on unchanged `dev` `9f0c242251cb`.
